item.title: 🚀 Paper Accepted at IEEE IPCCC 2025, Austin Texas
item.description:
Happy to announce that our research paper on drone-based imaging has been accepted for presentation at the 44th IEEE IPCCC 2025, which will be held in Austin, Texas, USA during the last week of November.

In this work, we focused on evaluating deep learning model performance in relation to computational complexity, providing insights into achieving efficient yet accurate solutions for real-world drone applications.

Looking forward to sharing our findings with the global research community at this prestigious conference!

item.title: 🚁 Field Visit to BAU with IUB Research Team – UAV Data Collection
item.description:
Recently, I had the opportunity to be part of a research team from the RIoT Center, Independent University, Bangladesh (IUB), on a visit to Bangladesh Agricultural University (BAU), Mymensingh.

Our mission was to conduct a research coordination meeting and perform UAV-based image data collection for an ongoing agricultural project. The experience was both technically enriching and inspiring, as we explored multidisciplinary remote sensing research opportunities with the Agriculture University, while also continuing our previous work.

Looking forward to contributing to meaningful research outcomes that can support the future of agricultural innovation in Bangladesh!

item.title: 🤖 Conducted Robotics Workshop at Cadet College – Inspiring Future Innovators
item.description:
It was an incredible experience to conduct a two-day Robotics Workshop at a Cadet College, where I had the opportunity to introduce young minds to the fundamentals of robotics and embedded systems. The workshop provided a practical introduction to working with simple sensors, actuators, and Arduino boards.

The cadets, full of curiosity and talent, quickly grasped the concepts and surprised us by building their own small projects — all from scratch and based on their unique ideas. Their enthusiasm and creativity were truly inspiring!

This initiative was aimed at kickstarting their journey into the world of robotics, and I believe some of these brilliant students will one day become pioneers in the field.

Wishing them all the best in their future endeavors. Looking forward to seeing some of them excel in robotics and technology in the years ahead!

item.title: 🤝 Volunteered at NCIM 2025 – A Memorable Day at DUET
item.description:
I had the pleasure of volunteering as part of the organizing committee for the INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON NEXT-GENERATION COMPUTING, IoT AND MACHINE LEARNING (NCIM) 2025, hosted by the Department of CSE, DUET.

Assigned to one of the main venues, I assisted in coordinating the Machine Learning track, which featured six sessions spread over two days. It was a deeply fulfilling experience to work alongside dedicated faculty members and enthusiastic students — especially meaningful as a proud graduate of DUET myself.

The highlight? Listening to researchers from across the country share their innovative work in ML. Noticed a strong focus on Explainable AI (XAI) — clearly a rising trend in current research!

Excited to see where the next wave of AI and ML research leads.
